description.en: Cross-session memory and self-evolution for DeepSeek Harness: memories are Markdown files on disk, a one-line-per-memory catalog is carried in the prompt instead of retrieved, and a background pass reviews tool calls for writes the main agent missed.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话记忆与自进化：记忆以 Markdown 文件存储在磁盘上，目录（每条记忆一行）随提示词携带而非检索；另有一轮后台复审，检查主 agent 漏写的部分。
